name: Signal in the Rot
goal: Retrieve the signal core from the dead mall.
premise: A dead-tech signal is pulsing out of the collapsed Meridian Mall, three days after it should have gone silent forever. Find the source. Find out why.

objectives.text: Recover a working component from Vending Row
Bypass the wards in the Humming Vault
Retrieve the signal core from the Static Warden
